ce_bugs.text: Migration INSERT interpolates raw host strings into SQL, allowing SQL injection or crashes on values containing quotes
EmbeddingController#update fetches and re-serializes an OpenStruct without reading params or saving, making it a silent no-op that reports success
Plural hydration in store.js.es6 can leave false/undefined entries in the hydrated array when a side-loaded record lookup fails, unlike the guarded singular branch
deleteHost action's destroyRecord().then() has no .catch, so a failed DELETE leaves the row with no error shown to the admin
Migration 20150818190757_interpolates host strings unescaped directly into raw INSERT SQL, breaking on quotes and creating a SQL injection vector via the setting value
Migration 20150818190757 crashes with NoMethodError when embed_category or uncategorized_category_id queries return zero rows (e.g. fresh installs)
_hydrateEmbedded maps every *_ids key unconditionally, producing arrays of undefined entries when a sub-type isn't found instead of skipping
Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#update passes a possibly-nil host into save_host without find/404, causing a 500 error on bad id
EmbeddableHostsController#update/#destroy raise unhandled 500 on unknown id because nil host is not handled
_hydrateEmbedded plural-id handling breaks on nil/empty entries, non-array values, and irregular plurals, crashing hydration
Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#create/update crashes with 500 when embeddable_host wrapper param is missing
Migration crashes with nil deref when embed_category setting is absent, since execute(...)[0]['id'] assumes a row exists (db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb:11-12)
SQL injection / migration failure from unescaped host setting values interpolated directly into INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts SQL (db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb:29-30)
Migrated hosts copied verbatim with http:// or https:// prefixes never match uri.host in EmbeddableHost.record_for_host, silently breaking embedding after upgrade
destroyRecord().then() in embeddable-host.js.es6 has no .catch, leaving unhandled promise rejection and no user feedback on delete failure
save_host doesn't validate category_id references an existing category, allowing dangling category_id and broken UI rendering
Store _hydrateEmbedded plural branch doesn't filter undefined results from _lookupSubType, and pluralize(subType) may not match serializer naming for irregulars
save_host on update will raise NoMethodError when no record matches params[:id] (nil.host = ...)
Migration uses hand-rolled SQL with string interpolation and subselects that can raise ([0]['id'] on empty result), with a cmd_tuples > 0 check, untested

_hydrateEmbedded pluralization change lacks tests for empty xyz_ids: [] array, a model with both x_id and x_ids, and _lookupSubType returning false/undefined inside the map (resulting array will contain false values and hydrated || [] never kicks in)
Test for find('fruit', 2) actually receives fruits[0] (apple) from the pretender — the fixture identity isn't tied to the id, so it verifies the mock, not the requested record
Migration crashes on fresh installs when embed_category/uncategorized_category_id site setting rows are absent, causing NoMethodError on nil from execute result

EmbeddableHostsController#update crashes with nil: params[:id] lookup with .first can return nil causing NoMethodError; params[:embeddable_host][:host] raises if key missing; update/destroy don't 404 on missing records
_hydrateEmbedded deletes *_ids key unconditionally even when hydration fails/empty, losing original ids; `hydrated || []` fallback never triggers since hydrated is an array

Migration is irreversible: DELETE FROM site_settings runs inside change, so rollback drops the table but never restores the deleted embeddable_hosts/embed_category settings rows, permanently destroying original configuration
Migration crashes on fresh/minimal installs: execute(...)[0]['id'] raises NoMethodError when no embed_category row exists, and the uncategorized_category_id fallback also assumes a row exists

Backfill inserts hosts raw without normalization: protocol-prefixed hosts like https://example.com will never match example.com under the new lower(host) = uri.host comparison, silently breaking embedding after upgrade
SQL built by string interpolation in migration INSERT: host values from admin-entered settings may contain quotes, causing crashes or SQL injection; should use quote/parameterized insert
force: true on create_table silently drops any pre-existing embeddable_hosts table, destroying data on environments where the table already exists
Admin controller crashes on unknown id: EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first can be nil, causing NoMethodError in save_host(nil) and destroy raising on nil, producing a 500 instead of 404/422
Admin::EmbeddingController#update never reads params or persists anything, returning success while saving nothing
EmbeddableHostsController crashes with NoMethodError when host record not found (nil) instead of returning 404
SQL interpolation in migration INSERT with raw string values enables SQL injection and breaks on quotes
EmbeddableHost before_validation raises NoMethodError/KeyError when host param is absent or nil
expandable_first_post? behavior change: returns true even with zero configured embeddable hosts
No uniqueness constraint or validation on embeddable_hosts.host, allowing duplicates with nondeterministic routing

mrv_findings.text: Migration crashes with NoMethodError when embed_category site setting is blank/never set (the default), because execute(...)[0] is nil and nil['id'] is dereferenced
Migration assumes embeddable_hosts setting is newline-delimited text but it's a serialized host_list (YAML array), so splitting yields garbage records inserted verbatim
Migration insert uses raw string interpolation '#{h}', so any quote in the value causes a SQL syntax error
Migration uses cmd_tuples (a PG::Result method) but ActiveRecord execute on MySQL returns a plain Array, crashing on MySQL
SELECT value FROM site_settings WHERE name = 'uncategorized_category_id' may return zero rows, making [0]['value'] another nil dereference
Admin embedding controller update action never reads params or saves anything, so the PUT save path is a no-op and client-side mutations are silently lost

Store.js _ids branch maps missing sub-type lookups to false/undefined and assigns the array as-is; || [] fallback only triggers when every lookup fails, so partially side-loaded payloads produce arrays with false holes causing template crashes
Migration create_embeddable_hosts.rb crashes on fresh installs because the embed_category inner-join query returns zero rows, making [0] nil and raising NoMethodError before the fallback is reached
Migration create_embeddable_hosts.rb interpolates host values raw into the INSERT SQL without escaping, so hosts containing apostrophes produce invalid SQL and abort the migration midway
EmbeddingController#update accepts a PUT but changes nothing and returns success, making it a silent no-op with missing persistence logic (or dead code)
EmbeddableHost model lacks a uniqueness validation and unique index, allowing duplicate hosts with different categories where record_for_host returns an arbitrary first match
EmbeddableHostsController update and destroy don't check host.present?, so nil records from stale ids raise unhandled 500s instead of 404/422
Host validation permits ports but record_for_host compares against uri.host (port stripped), so hosts saved with ports never match and the feature silently fails
Controller specs only assert class ancestry with zero functional verification of CRUD endpoints, error rendering, fallbacks, or nil-id 404 paths; no JS tests for the embeddable-host component either
Topic#expandable_first_post? dropped the embeddable_hosts.present? guard, changing behavior for hostless sites that still have topic_embeds with embed_truncate enabled
Migration deletes site settings via raw SQL without flushing SiteSetting's in-process cache, leaving long-running processes with stale phantom values

Fabricator file contents swapped: category fabricators moved into embeddable_host_fabricator.rb and embeddable_host fabricator into category_fabricator.rb, breaking convention-based tooling and future edits
admin/embedding_controller.rb update action is a no-op endpoint that fetches and re-renders the embedding without applying any params — dead code
_hydrateEmbedded in store.js.es6 is core shared infrastructure modified globally to hydrate any *_ids key, expanding scope beyond the feature's requirement
Migration dereferences [0] on the embed_category query result unconditionally, crashing with NoMethodError when no category matches (empty/renamed settings)
Migration string-interpolates raw embeddable_hosts site-setting values into SQL INSERT, breaking on quote characters instead of using parameterized inserts
update action on missing id calls host.destroy/nil.host on nil, causing 500 instead of 404 when a host was already deleted
No uniqueness validation or unique index on host, allowing duplicate host rows; record_for_host .first makes category selection nondeterministic
create action crashes with NoMethodError when embeddable_host param is missing, returning 500 instead of 400
EmbeddingController#update never applies params, so the Save Changes button silently does nothing

Migration lacks unique index on host, index on category_id, and FK; record_for_host lower(host) lookup is a full table scan on the hot embed path, and create path never downcases so case-variant duplicates are allowed
Hostname regex validation rejects valid hosts like localhost, TLDs > 5 chars, and punycode, breaking previously accepted embed hosts
before_validation uses sub! on possibly non-String host, crashing on nil, and normalization of case never happens so stored-case vs lookup-case mismatch is papered over by lower()
topic_embed.rb category from embed host is nil when host not in table, so topics silently post to uncategorized instead of falling back to embed_category setting
host.save success path: Discourse.Category.findById throws if categoryId is null, and returns undefined for uncategorized leaving badge rendering broken

REST adapter type.replace('_','-') rewrites all type names; embeddable-host createRecord may 404 against /admin/embeddable_hosts due to unverified pluralization, plus parallel-path asymmetry of two adapters/endpoints
EmbeddingSerializer embed: :ids hydrated subtypes are plain store objects without .save, so host.save(props) may throw on save
Migration crashes on fresh installs when embed_category setting row is absent (execute result nil['id'])
SQL injection/quote-breaking in migration INSERT via unescaped interpolation of setting value and category_id
Stacked didInsertElement and editing observers cause _focusOnInput to run when editing turns off, plus categoryId mirror state can drift from host.category.id
Migration crashes with NoMethodError on sites where embed_category site setting was never set, because execute("SELECT c.id ... WHERE s.name = 'embed_category'")[0]['id'] assumes the row exists
Migration irreversibly deletes site settings rows (embeddable_hosts, embed_category) with no down path, permanently losing admin-configured hosts and category if rollback or mis-import occurs
Unescaped string interpolation of raw setting values into INSERT SQL; a host value containing a quote breaks the INSERT or corrupts the row; should use sanitized/quoted values
Admin::EmbeddingController#update is a silent no-op that persists nothing while the UI exposes a save action, so admins click save, get success, and nothing changes
Admin::EmbeddableHostsController update (and destroy) uses where(id: params[:id]).first without a nil check, causing NoMethodError/500 on stale or unknown ids instead of 404

Category fabricators were moved into the wrong file: the contents of category_fabricator.rb (including :category, :diff_category, :happy_category, :private_category) now live in embeddable_host_fabricator.rb and vice versa, a misleading naming inversion

expandable_first_post? guard SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts.present? was removed, widening expand behavior to any topic with a topic_embed when embed_truncate is on, silently changing rendering for pre-existing topics

Topic imports now take category from EmbeddableHost.record_for_host(url) instead of global embed_category; unmatched feed URLs land topics in uncategorized, silently changing destination category for existing feed-polling installs

SQL string interpolation of unsanitized admin-entered embeddable_hosts setting value in migration 20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb line 29, allowing broken migrations or SQL injection; should use sanitize_sql/quote or EmbeddableHost.create!

Controller specs (embedding_controller_spec.rb, embeddable_hosts_controller_spec.rb) only assert class inheritance, verifying nothing about behavior; EmbeddingController#update never mutates @embedding yet the client calls saveChanges, and no test catches this
No test for EmbeddableHost validation failure path (invalid host strings) or the controller's host.save failure branch; the host format regex has no coverage
EmbeddableHost.record_for_host untested for malformed/non-URI input and its false return; TopicEmbed.import path where eh is nil (topic posts to nil category) is untested
expandable_first_post? dropped the host check but the spec still fabricates an embeddable host in a before block, documenting the wrong invariant (mirror-test)
Embed controller's referer-check reject branch with a populated EmbeddableHost table and a foreign referer is untested

Migration data transfer of embeddable_hosts/embed_category settings into rows has zero test coverage; the name-based category join silently falls to uncategorized when a category was renamed, untested
New admin UI component/controller/adapter (embeddable-host.js.es6) with ~100 lines of save/cancel/edit/cantSave/pathFor logic has zero JS tests

Store _hydrateEmbedded plural path only tested with well-formed ids; dangling plural ids (missing sidecar object) yield undefined entries in the hydrated array, untested, and the || [] fallback is dead code
Migration irreversibly deletes site_settings rows ('embeddable_hosts', 'embed_category') with no backup or down-migration, making data unrecoverable on rollback
Migration crashes with NoMethodError when 'embed_category' setting is unset because [0]['id'] dereferences nil
Fallback lookup queries nonexistent 'uncategorized_category_id' site_settings row, so [0]['value'] raises NoMethodError and the fallback path is broken
Backfill INSERT interpolates raw host values unescaped, so hosts with single quotes break the SQL and risk a partially-applied migration
create_table uses force: true, silently dropping any pre-existing embeddable_hosts table and its data
embeddable_hosts.category_id has no foreign key or dependent cleanup, leaving orphaned references when a category is deleted
Backfill matches category by name instead of id, which can miss or silently assign the wrong category

No deploy-window safety for removed embeddable_hosts/embed_category settings: rolling deploys crash on removed constants and TopicEmbed.import falls back to nil/default category instead of the old per-site default
